posts.title: Quorem Ripsum
posts.description: A simple web tool to generate a realistic looking QR code that is not really scannable. Useful for creating QR code placeholders for your designs. posts.title: Oare Sans
posts.description: oare n. [o.ˈa.ɾɛ] moon Oare Sans is a condensed display sans-serif typeface that combines narrow proportions with open apertures and distinctive letterforms. Letters such as C and S bring an open quality to its compact design, while the uppercase J descends below the baseline, its tail pairing with the curve of the preceding letter.
